title: $\tau^2$-Bench: Evaluating Conversational Agents in a Dual-Control Environment
problem: Existing benchmarks for conversational AI agents simulate _single-control_ environments, where only the AI agent can use tools to interact with the world, while the user remains a passive information provider
approach: This differs from real-world scenarios like technical support, where users need to actively participate in modifying the state of the (shared) world
